title: 食物冲突显示器
description: Food scanner & recipe conflict detector with one-click export to CSV/JSON.
body:
# Food Scanner & Recipe Checker

A lightweight mod that scans all food items from every installed mod and detects recipe conflicts. Simply press **F6** (configurable) to open the UI and see a complete list of foods, identify duplicate names, and find items with multiple crafting recipes. Export detailed conflict reports to CSV, JSON, or TXT files with one click. All reports are saved to `config/version-folder/exports/`. Perfect for modpack developers and server admins who need to quickly analyze and troubleshoot recipe issues. Clean interface, no bloat—just scan, check, and export.
